title: L3-L4 facet force at 7.5 Nm after injury, Tekscan (linear vs two-point calibration)
condition: injured L3-L4 (nucleotomy + capsule and posterior ligament sectioning)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: peak resultant facet contact force per facet (Tekscan), mean of 5 trials per facet, 4 specimens x 2 sides; both calibration methods (linear recommended)

source.authors: Wilson DC, Niosi CA, Zhu QA, Oxland TR, Wilson DR
source.sample: 4 human cadaveric L2-L5 lumbar spines, injured at L3-L4 (nucleotomy, facet capsule sectioning, posterior ligament sectioning); Tekscan in both L3-L4 facets

protocol.summary: L2-L5 specimens, L2 and L5 potted in dental stone; L3-L4 injured (nucleotomy, capsule sectioning, posterior ligament sectioning); continuous pure moments +-7.5 Nm at average 1.3 deg/s, unconstrained custom spine tester; 5 trials each in axial rotation and flexion-extension, each trial 3 loading cycles; no preload; peak resultant force per facet per trial, averaged over 5 trials.
how_to_simulate: Model L2-L5 with L3-L4 nucleotomy, cut L3-L4 capsules and posterior ligaments (ISL, SSL, LF)
Fix L5; apply pure moment +-7.5 Nm to L2 in axial rotation and in flexion-extension, no preload
Report peak resultant L3-L4 facet contact force for left and right facets (AR: each facet's peak over the bilateral test; EX: at peak extension moment)
protocol.notes: Method: Tekscan I-Scan 6900 (rated 7.6 MPa; 11x11 grid of 1.6 mm2 sensels per element), lubricated, inserted into the L3-L4 facets after capsule sectioning; conditioned 5x at 120 N; linear (80 N) vs two-point (20/80 N) calibration. Accuracy vs known compressive loads on excised facets (n=4 facets, 1 excluded): linear calibration overestimated by 18+-9% (100 N), 35+-7% (50 N), 50+-9% (25 N); two-point by 35+-16%, 45+-7%, 56+-10%. Repeatability (SD as % of mean over 5 trials): force 4% AR / 7% EX (linear). In AR linear-calibrated force was 30+-7% smaller than two-point; in EX 0+-5% difference. Specimens were INJURED at L3-L4 (not intact) - use for method/tolerance and for an injured-segment check only.

extraction.uncertainty: +-1 N (pixel scan of bar tops at 200 dpi; 0.37 N/px panel A, 0.15 N/px panel B)
extraction.check_notes: Bar tops found by colour mask; legend squares excluded. Cross-check vs text: linear/two-point difference in AR computed from digitised bars = 29,34,35,24,33,41,19,25% (mean 30%, text 30+-7%); EX differences within +-10% (text 0+-5%). Visual re-read of A-left bars (63/89) and D-left EX (43/48) agrees.

pass_rule.rule: min <= model <= max (linear calibration); widen by the method overestimation (18-50%)
